description: App-side diacritic delta for better-trigram; canonical source of truth for every language. Pipeline: normalize -> strip combining marks (\p{M}) -> apply this table. Use NFD (recommended): canonical decomposition only, so accents fold while ligatures, symbols, fractions and fullwidth forms are left intact. Use NFKD only if you also want compatibility folding (ﬁ->fi, ½->1⁄2, ①->1, ａ->a), accepting the extra false matches. NFKD implies NFD, so pick one. Neither covers strokes/dots (Ø Đ Ħ ı Ł Þ) nor ß->ss, which is case folding, not decomposition - that is what this table is for. `from` is exactly one codepoint; `to` is 1..N codepoints and expands. Do not inline these mappings in application code.
